1.title: An 86-minute guide to finding PMF | Rob Snyder (Author, The Power of Pull)
1.author: Lenny's Podcast
1.hook: Rob Snyder's PULL framework for early-stage PMF (Project, Unavoidable, List of options, Limitations); cold outreach tactics, first sales calls, pricing mechanics, and applying the framework inside established companies. 86 minutes covering idea validation through first customers.
